key_decisions: The stable registry identity remains io.github.asfbay-bit/opchain-skills after the source repository transfer to a-atx/opchain.
The publisher authenticates with the existing scoped MIRROR_TOKEN because GitHub OIDC cannot claim the legacy asfbay-bit registry namespace from the new repository owner.
A validate-only publisher dispatch on exact main must prove validation and authentication before the immutable tag is created.
Hosted checkpoint sessions are server-issued UUID plus canonical HMAC tokens; production and staging use distinct secrets, and rotation invalidates existing tokens.
The 16 legacy production checkpoint records were incompatible with signed sessions and were irreversibly deleted only after the hardened production runtime was verified.
Every deploy must use the exact fetched origin/main commit. Production has no branch escape hatch.
Production post-activation verification failure automatically rolls back to the captured prior 100%-traffic version ID.
Compliance is readiness and evidence only; no compliance framework is activated because .opchain/compliance.yaml is absent.
